# Cālātherīgāthā (Thig 7.2)

**ID:** Thig 7.2
**Section:** Therīgāthā (thig)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Cālātherīgāthā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0509m.mul6.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Parallels also occur in Chinese and Sanskrit Dharmapada/Udānavarga traditions (T 210.22, T 212.28, T 213.27, UV 27, and Tibetan Uv Kg 27), and the text is cited in the *Nettippakaraṇa* (*Sāsanapaṭṭhāna*, Ne 37).

Comparative Āgama scholarship similarly records Chinese Saṁyuktāgama discourse parallels concerning Māra's confrontation with the nun Cālā (折羅比丘尼) [Bingenheimer 2011].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Passage-level parallels: dhp191; divy Divyāvadāna; Iti 24 (It 1.24 PTS It 17) Aṭṭhipuñja Sutta; SN 15.10 Puggalasutta; T 210.22 述佛品法句經第二十二二十有一章; T 212.28 觀品第二十八; T 213.27 法集要頌經觀察品第二十七; Thag 21.1 Vaṅgīsattheragāthā; Thig 7.3 Upacālātherīgāthā; Thig 13.3 Cāpātherīgāthā; Thig 13.4 Sundarītherīgāthā; UV 27 Paśyavarga; Uv Kg 27 Sight
- Mentioned in: Ne 37 Sāsanapaṭṭhāna

**Sources**

- [Bingenheimer 2011] Marcus Bingenheimer, Studies in Āgama Literature: With Special Reference to the Shorter Chinese Saṃyuktāgama (2011) — Table of Chinese Saṃyuktāgama parallels to the Bhikkhunī Saṃyutta / Therīgāthā traditions of Cālā.
